purpose: Test residual registration of the exact local ASF partial VV pair, and only if it passes, render an explicitly exploratory local continuous backscatter-difference map without admitting an M4 scientific candidate.
proposed_one_conditional_envelope: Publish the exact review packet and owner decision, then implement only the fixed-source registration and continuous-VV-delta route with synthetic and installed ArcGIS disposable tests, public CI, and one final no-content preflight. No intermediate owner reconfirmation is required within unchanged approved scope.

Before a real pixel read, recheck the exact staged raster hashes, grid, rights for local derivative display, available disk, and a collision-free new append-only attempt root. Lock a deterministic stable-reference/control-window selection method from approved geometry and non-change evidence, excluding the event corridor. Stop if 30 usable control windows cannot be predeclared without looking at the pair's difference signal.

Run at most one fresh local real attempt that reads only the two exact staged VV dB rasters. Measure residual registration on at least 30 predeclared control windows, retaining per-window offsets and rejected-window reasons. A pass requires RMSE at most 0.5 pixel and absolute x and y bias at most 0.5 pixel; indeterminate or failed registration stops before any delta raster or map is produced. No shift, resampling, or control reselection is allowed in this envelope.

Only after that registration pass, compute one continuous after-minus-before VV gamma0 dB raster solely on exact common-valid cells. Retain raw values and the predeclared exclusions; do not speckle-filter, threshold, classify, polygonize, or infer geomorphic or causal change. Preserve an exact input, output, mask, registration, and pixel-statistics receipt outside Git.

Render one local EPSG:32645 ArcGIS Pro before/after/continuous-delta layout with true dates, a quantitative signed dB legend, valid and excluded area, source credits and DOI references, and prominent partial-coverage, unfiltered-speckle, terrain/moisture/vegetation, and non-attribution warnings. Reopen in a separate ArcGIS process, export, inspect visually, and audit broken paths and hashes. Keep all raster, APRX, and export bytes outside Git; publish only sanitized terminal evidence and exact public-CI reconciliation.
stop_conditions: Any input identity, grid, rights, or public-CI gate fails or is indeterminate.
At least 30 control windows cannot be selected without examining the before/after difference signal.
Residual registration exceeds the unchanged 0.5-pixel RMSE or bias bounds, or cannot be measured reproducibly.
Any unknown mask, nonfinite or unexpected unit value, output-path collision, broken ArcGIS layer, missing credit, or export/audit failure occurs.
decision_requested: Approve, revise, or defer this one registration-first, local exploratory VV-delta envelope through sanitized terminal publication. Approval would release no scientific candidate, attribution, or public pixel publication.
